entities.summary: Danny Akintunde Agbelese is an American-Nigerian professional basketball player for Palmer Basket of the Spanish Primera FEB. After two years at Collin College, and two years at Hampton, Agbelese entered the 2012 NBA draft, but he was not selected in the draft's two rounds. He was named MVP of the Greek Super Cup in 2020.
